assets.name: -update.zip
assets.pre_install_message:
Install MooSwitch Update Pack?

Updates CFW, patches, overlays, and homebrew while preserving your configs, sysmodule toggles, and cowMMC setup.

If updating Switch firmware, quarantine custom Home Menu themes first (Ultrahand -> MooSwitch Tools).
assets.post_install_message:
MooSwitch Update Pack installed.

Reboot your Switch immediately (Sphaira Power Menu or Ultrahand -> Reboot to Hekate / Nyx) to apply the update.

assets.name: .zip
assets.pre_install_message:
Install MooSwitch Full Pack?

WARNING: Overwrites your configs (Hekate, Nyx, Atmosphere, Sphaira, Ultrahand, sys-con, cowMMC guard) and resets default sysmodule boot toggles.

Select the -update.zip asset instead to preserve your settings.
assets.post_install_message:
MooSwitch Full Pack installed.

Reboot your Switch immediately (Sphaira Power Menu or Ultrahand -> Reboot to Hekate / Nyx) to apply the update.
